name: ResetRandomPosition
description: Creates spheres during simulation, placing them at random positions. Every time called, one new sphere will be created and inserted in the simulation.

attributes.name: angularVelocityRange
attributes.description: Half size of a angularVelocity distribution interval. New sphere will have random angularVelocity within the range angularVelocity±angularVelocityRange.

attributes.name: factoryFacets
attributes.description: The geometry of the section where spheres will be placed; they will be placed on facets or in volume between them depending on *volumeSection* flag.

attributes.name: initRun
attributes.description: Run the first time we are called as well.

attributes.name: iterPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using step number (deactivated if <= 0)

attributes.name: maxAttempts
attributes.description: Max attempts to place sphere. If placing the sphere in certain random position would cause an overlap with any other physical body in the model, SpheresFactory will try to find another position.

attributes.name: nDo
attributes.description: Limit number of executions by this number (deactivated if negative)

attributes.name: realPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using real (wall clock, computation, human) time in seconds (deactivated if <=0)

attributes.name: velocityRange
attributes.description: Half size of a velocities distribution interval. New sphere will have random velocity within the range velocity±velocityRange.

attributes.name: virtPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using virtual (simulation) time (deactivated if <= 0)

attributes.name: volumeSection
attributes.description: Create new spheres inside factory volume rather than on its surface.
